title: Age at first alto and trombone, and the Roussel Street house
summary: Alto at five and a half, trombone at about ten, and where he lived.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I'm not sure, now that's what we have on that early tape, but I want to be sure about some of those, not dates necessary, but how old were you when you first took up music,
your alto horn you say? I was about five and a half, six years old.
Uh huh. And then how old were you when you got your first trombone? If you can remember, if not exactly, just about?
About ten, and you didn't have long pants then of course?
No. That's the way bloomers with a uniform and a cap, you know, with Lane on the cap.
You got that trombone at a pawn shop you say?

No, well I didn't have the trombone until I played this date with, I was supposed to play upright alto that night. And Lane's brother-in-law didn't show up, lay on smallos, so the trombone was there, he says try to play the trombone.
And after I liked the trombone, I went to the hawk shop and bought me one.
Yeah. That's crazy. And did you live down in that neighborhood all the time you lived in New Orleans until you moved up here?
2135, the house is still there, I was down there. Well still there. But in the neighborhood you wouldn't know it.
I'll take a picture of it sometime.
There's a corner store there now, there's two houses, second house.
